rationale: Released CorrStats support weak attn–gradient alignment across many configs; trained tiny-model probe shows non-trivial prediction-preserving attention changes. Full official retrain blocked.

audit_corrstats.interpretation: Released CorrStats show median attention–gradient Kendall τ (ag) well below strong correlation; often below gradient self-consistency (gl).

extension_counterfactual_probe.note: Trained tiny BiGRU+attention on synthetic token-presence task; tests whether alternate attention can preserve argmax. NOT a full SST/IMDB replication of Jain & Wallace.

official_full_retrain.reason: Upstream requires pytorch-nightly/source + torchtext 0.4 from source + dataset preprocess; not executed end-to-end in this environment.

executor_note: Scores for usefulness are for independent reviewer only.
